mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 50-day moving average signals an expansion in economic activity, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 50-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 200-day moving average signals an expansion in economic activity, leading to increased demand for raw materials and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 200-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above 1.5 million units signals an expansion in the housing market, leading to increased demand for housing-related goods and services, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 2% and a decline in the consumer price index below 2% signals a tightening of monetary policy and low inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high interest rates and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment above 200,000 jobs and a decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high job growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales above 5% year-over-year and a decline in the personal savings rate below 5% signals an expansion in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).
